extension.description: Box Tuner, Patch Guard and the Nimbus Homatics skin. Install once; Kodi then offers updates by itself.

extension.summary: Settings profile for the Homatics box
extension.description: Applies a tuned set of Umbrella, Otaku and Kodi settings (taken from the PC set-up, without any logins or PC-only options). Every change is backed up first and can be undone from the menu. Also: picture-cache clean-up (button + about once a month when idle), backup / restore and a weekly backup through the Kodi Backup add-on, and a debug-log switch for tests.

extension.summary: Notices when an addon update removes a local fix, and re-applies it
extension.description: Keeps a list of small local fixes to other addons and skins. After an update it checks each one, tells you which are missing, and can put them back safely: the original file is backed up first, python files are syntax-checked, and nothing is written unless every change can be placed with certainty.
extension.news: 0.2.6 - anime show items from the watchlist rows get their long-press entries; movies and episodes: Play first; Browse Collection / Find similar work from Home rows; Browse Seasons on TV shows; an empty Favourite TV Shows list no longer errors. 0.1.6 - can upgrade an older copy of a fix (fixes the "cannot place" on otaku-browser-retry after the 0.1.3 edition). 0.1.5 - box edition: fix list refreshes itself when a newer one ships inside the add-on; adds Next Up total-episode fix, Umbrella next-episode fix and source-handling fix. 0.1.1 - the menu is now the primary feature so Kodi shows a Run button and lists it under Program add-ons (the background service still starts with Kodi). 0.1.0 - first version: detect, report, manual re-apply, optional automatic re-apply, rollback.
